name: Process or pod crash
codebook_line: F1 Process or pod crash. A. Chaos Mesh PodChaos pod-kill, container-kill; Litmus pod-delete, container-kill, spring-boot-app-kill.

name: Node, VM or instance loss
codebook_line: F2 Node, VM or instance loss. A. Chaos Mesh AWSChaos ec2-stop and ec2-restart, GCPChaos node-stop and node-reset, AzureChaos vm-stop and vm-restart, PodChaos pod-failure; Litmus node-drain, node-restart, node-poweroff, kubelet-service-kill, docker-service-kill, ec2-stop-by-id, gcp-vm-instance-stop, azure-instance-stop, vm-poweroff.

name: Zone or data-center loss
codebook_line: F3 Zone or data-center loss, only when the report says a whole zone or data center was lost; part of a facility is F2. A on AWS only (Litmus aws-az-chaos); P elsewhere (several node stops at once).

name: Region-wide or control-plane loss
codebook_line: F4 Region-wide or provider control-plane loss. N.

name: Network latency
codebook_line: F5 Network latency. A. Chaos Mesh NetworkChaos delay, HTTPChaos delay, BlockChaos delay; Litmus pod-network-latency, pod-http-latency.

name: Packet loss, corruption or duplication
codebook_line: F6 Packet loss, corruption or duplication. A. Chaos Mesh NetworkChaos loss, corrupt, duplicate; Litmus pod-network-loss, pod-network-corruption, pod-network-duplication.

name: Network partition or link loss
codebook_line: F7 Network partition or link loss between components. A. Chaos Mesh NetworkChaos partition; Litmus pod-network-partition, pod-http-reset-peer.

name: Network capacity saturation
codebook_line: F8 Network capacity saturation. A. Chaos Mesh NetworkChaos bandwidth; Litmus pod-network-rate-limit.

name: DNS resolution failure
codebook_line: F9 DNS resolution failure. A. Chaos Mesh DNSChaos error, random; Litmus pod-dns-error, pod-dns-spoof.

name: CPU exhaustion
codebook_line: F10 CPU exhaustion. A. Chaos Mesh StressChaos cpu; Litmus pod-cpu-hog, node-cpu-hog.

name: Memory exhaustion
codebook_line: F11 Memory exhaustion or leak. A. Chaos Mesh StressChaos memory; Litmus pod-memory-hog, node-memory-hog.

name: Storage fault
codebook_line: F12 Storage fault: disk full, I/O errors or latency, volume loss. A. Chaos Mesh IOChaos latency and fault, AWSChaos detach-volume, GCPChaos disk-loss, AzureChaos disk-detach; Litmus disk-fill, pod-io-stress, node-io-stress, ebs-loss-by-id, gcp-vm-disk-loss, azure-disk-loss.

name: Clock or time fault
codebook_line: F13 Clock or time fault. A in Chaos Mesh only (TimeChaos); none in the Litmus catalog.

name: Error responses or exceptions
codebook_line: F14 Error responses or exceptions from a service. A. Chaos Mesh HTTPChaos abort, replace, patch, JVMChaos exception; Litmus pod-http-status-code, pod-http-modify-body, spring-boot-exceptions.

name: Bad configuration state
codebook_line: F15 Bad configuration state spread to running systems. P. Closest: Chaos Mesh IOChaos mistake or attrOverride on a config file, HTTPChaos replace on a config service's answer.

name: Internal dependency unavailable
codebook_line: F16 A dependency inside the provider becomes unavailable, as the report states. A third party's outage is the trigger T10; the provider's own service that failed with it is F16. A. Partition or abort the calls to it (F7 or F14 faults aimed at the dependency).

name: Credential, certificate or authentication failure
codebook_line: F17 Credential, certificate or authentication failure. P. Closest: Chaos Mesh TimeChaos moved past the expiry date.

name: Software resource limit
codebook_line: F18 Software resource limit hit: connection pool, thread pool, file handles, quota or rate limit inside a service. P. Closest: Litmus k6-loadgen load against the limit.

name: Data corruption or inconsistent state
codebook_line: F19 Data corruption or inconsistent state. P. Closest: Chaos Mesh IOChaos mistake.

name: Overload or retry storm
codebook_line: F20 Overload or retry storm: queues back up or clients retry, from demand or from a failure, whether or not the system recovered alone. P. Closest: Litmus k6-loadgen with a dependency fault (F14 or F16).
